content.text: Install the plugin in Claude Code or Codex
The plugin gives the agent ShowAI's tools and a set of skills; the ShowAI app keeps the pages and provides the runtime the plugin talks to. You
install the app first; the plugin comes with it
, so you need neither the source code nor a separate Node.js installation.

steps.title: Install the ShowAI app
steps.body: You need a Mac with Apple silicon (macOS 13 or later) and Claude Code or Codex, installed and signed in. For download and first launch, see [Installation & Setup](doc:install).

steps.title: Open the plugin panel
steps.body: The welcome screen on first launch, or Settings → Plugins at any time.

steps.title: Install plugin
steps.body: Click Install plugin next to Claude Code or Codex. ShowAI installs through the agent's own plugin commands, so the agent's command-line tool must be available (`claude --version` or `codex --version`); on macOS, ShowAI also checks the standard Codex app locations for its bundled CLI.
steps.result: Shows “Installed and enabled”; the installed files and enabled state are verified.

steps.title: Reload the agent and start a new conversation
steps.body: Restart the Claude Code session, or refresh plugins or restart Codex. A conversation that was already open keeps its old tool list.

steps.body:

The local launcher only looks for the runtime registered in the selected library. Incompatible versions and connection failures are reported clearly; it does not switch to another library, and the agent does not fall back to the CLI or an unsaved web page.
Every agent connected to ShowAI edits a page the same way: read the complete page, save with its version, then present it. Step through the process below.

steps.label: "Add a comparison table to this report"
steps.detail: You just have to say what to do. The Agent decides which tools to call based on the skill description.

steps.label: showai_capabilities
steps.detail: For the first operation, call `showai_capabilities `first, and then use `project_context `to check the connection type, available items and display capabilities. Each subsequent item operation passes `projectId `explicitly.

steps.label: List of projects and pages
steps.detail: To find existing content, the agent uses `projects_list`, `pages_list` or `library_search`. Read-only lookup does not create projects.

steps.label: page_read
steps.detail: Read the complete page and note the `hash `and `revision `returned, as well as the node ID to be modified.

steps.label: page_apply
steps.detail: The agent sends the hash and revision from its read and changes only the relevant nodes. If the page changed in the meantime, the save returns a conflict, and the agent must compare both versions and merge them rather than overwrite.

steps.label: Save new version
steps.detail: The page is saved to your selected project. The remote connection also synchronizes to the server and returns a sync receipt.

steps.label: App loads the update
steps.detail: If the app has no unsaved edits, it loads the new content directly; if it does, conflict handling opens and both versions are kept.

steps.label: page_present
steps.detail: Shows the saved page without changing it. Returns full HTML, source file, and in-session preview.

steps.label: Show results in conversation
steps.detail: Agents that support MCP Apps display the reader directly; Codex uses a local visualization; otherwise the agent hands you the HTML file.

content.text: returns several deliverables, and the agent uses whichever the host can handle. The full HTML and source always contain the whole page; when a preview is too large, the agent presents selected blocks and still delivers the full page.

DeepSeek Harness installs plugins itself, so ShowAI prepares a complete plugin package for it, with tools bound to the current runtime and library, the skills, and in-conversation page previews.

steps.title: Open DeepSeek Harness once
steps.body: This lets it create its desktop profile. If ShowAI can't find it, the panel asks you to install it and open it once, then click Check again.

steps.title: Prepare the plugin in ShowAI
steps.body: Open Settings → Plugins and click Prepare plugin next to DeepSeek Harness. The panel lists the plugin package path and any old configuration to remove first.

steps.title: Add and enable it in DeepSeek Harness
steps.body: In the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, open Plugins → Add plugin and paste the path. After installing, choose Enable now, then restart DeepSeek Harness.
steps.result: New conversations can use the ShowAI tools and preview pages in the conversation.

content.text: After updating ShowAI or switching libraries, click Update plugin files in Settings → Plugins and restart DeepSeek Harness; there is no need to add it again.
